title: Add a small pure util with a proof (spec-exact behavior)
prompt: Add an exported pure function summarizeSeatStates(seats: Array<{state: string}>): string to src/components/party/tones.ts that renders the /party telemetry rollup text: given seat rows, return '<busy> busy · <idle> idle' counting states exactly equal to 'busy' and 'idle' (all other states ignored), e.g. 2 busy + 1 idle ⇒ '2 busy · 1 idle'; zero seats ⇒ '0 busy · 0 idle'. Add scripts/party/prove-tones-rollup.ts (sibling-proof style) asserting those three cases plus a mixed-state case with degraded/dead rows ignored. Suite must stay green.
